source_tier: The generators are driven by two Westinghouse 501F combustion turbines burning natural gas as primary fuel, LPG as secondary, and No. 2 oil as backup (per the DRNA Title V permit),
source_notes: CCJ (2012 plant report): 'Three generators produce power for sale and internal use—two are driven by the gas turbines and rated 205 MVA each at 0.85 pf, one by the steam turbine and rated 252 MVA at 0.85 pf.' ... 'Two station service transformers, each rated 42 MVA, step down the voltage from 18 kV to 4.16 kV. An additional step down to 480 V provides power to a dozen motor control centers throughout the facility.' Same article establishing 'facility' = the integrated terminal+plant site: 'When EcoElectrica began commercial operation in March 2000 ... it was the only generating station in the world with an integrated LNG terminal ... It continues as the only such facility in the Western Hemisphere today.' DRNA Title V permit (PFE-TV-4911-57-0899-0006): 'EcoEléctrica propose the operation a marine unloading terminal for liquefied natural gas and a combined cycle cogeneration plant' [as one permitted facility]; and on direction of the OTHER flow (unchanged finding, not restaged): 'the storage tanks will be vaporized to form natural gas, which will be used as fuel in the combustion turbines.'
